About This Business

ARS/Rescue Rooter provides heating, cooling, plumbing, electrical, and indoor air quality services, including repair, installation, and maintenance. The company assists clients with system inspections, emergency repairs, and preventative maintenance for residential properties. Services cover air conditioning units, furnaces, water heaters, duct cleaning, attic insulation, and electrical wiring.

BBB Accredited Since: 3/15/2005

Years in Business: 31

Air Conditioning Maintenance, Air Conditioning Repair, Air Conditioning Replacement, Air Scrubber, Attic Fan Services, Attic Ventilation, Carbon Monoxide Detectors, Ceiling Fan Installation, Circuit Breakers, Drain Services, Dual-Fuel, Duct Cleaning, Ductless Mini Split, Electrical Outlets, Exhaust Fans, Garbage Disposal Service, Gas Line Service, Generator Services, Geothermal, Heat Pump Installation, Heat Pump Maintenance, Heat Pump Repair, Heating Installation, Heating System Maintenance, Heating System Repair, HVAC Inspection, Insulation Services, Lighting Installation, Nest Cams, Nest Protect, Nest Thermostats, Plumbing Installation, Plumbing Repair, Radiant Barrier, Radiant Cooling, Radiant Heating, Sewer Repair, Smoke Alarm Installation, Sump Pump Service, Swamp Cooler, Tankless Water Heaters, UV Air Cleaning, Vent Cleaning, Water Heater Services, Water Line Repair, Whole Home Dehumidifier, Whole Home Humidifier, Wiring Services, Zoned HVAC
